rationale: M49 #758 B5: get/set pairs collapsed to one symbol via the owner:name dedup key — the getter was deadSpanned (nested symbols pruned, body calls skipped) and the setter's body walked under the getter's slot. Contract now: accessor pairs emit BOTH Property symbols with accessorKind metadata and BOTH bodies' calls (val->track AND val->wrap). Cross-kind: a data member REPLACES the whole descriptor slot — Overwrite.x must be exactly ONE method symbol (pre-fix residue: the killed accessor half survived as a zombie); makeX() must NOT emit (the accessor's body is dead when the data member replaces it). B4: static Sub2.greet2 must NOT override instance Base2.greet2 (pre-fix fabricated Sub2.greet2->Base2.greet2 for every static/same-name pair).

forbidSymbols.name: x
forbidSymbols.note: no accessor half survives a data-member replacement

forbidRelationships.note: Overwrite accessor body is dead once the data member replaces the slot
